lead: Atal Bihari Vajpayee was an Indian politician, born on 24 December 1924 in Gwalior.
He died on 16 August 2018 in New Delhi at the age of 93.
He has held the office of Prime Minister of India and Prime Minister of India and has been recognised with Bharat Ratna and Ig Nobel Prize.
Below you will find a verified overview of Atal Bihari Vajpayee: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Atal Bihari Vajpayee — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Atal Bihari Vajpayee was born on 24 December 1924 in Gwalior, and holds Indian nationality.
His listed education includes Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar University, St. Mary's School, Belgaum and DAV College, Kanpur.
He is recorded as speaking Hindi and English.

sections.heading: Atal Bihari Vajpayee — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician, poet, journalist and writer as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Prime Minister of India (1998–2004), Prime Minister of India (1996–1996), member of Rajya Sabha, Minister of External Affairs (1977–1979), Member of the 11th Lok Sabha and Member of the 12th Lok Sabha. He is affiliated with Bharatiya Janata Party.
